# Hash-pinned RUNTIME closure for reproducible worker installs:
#
#   pip install --require-hashes -r requirements-lock.txt
#   pip install --no-deps .
#
# Profile: CPython 3.14 / linux-amd64 (the shipped container images and
# the reference scheduled-worker platform). The pure-Python wheels
# (meraki, requests, ...) are platform-independent; the compiled ones
# (aiohttp, multidict, yarl, ...) are pinned to the manylinux cp314
# wheels — on another platform or interpreter, regenerate instead of
# editing by hand:
#
#   pip download meraki==<version> -d /tmp/wheels
#   sha256sum /tmp/wheels/*  →  update the entries below
#
# Rationale (CLAUDE.md / pyproject): an unattended worker rebuild
# mid-incident must not silently pull an untested or tampered SDK.
# Dev tooling is NOT pinned here — this file is only the runtime bill
# of materials; see requirements.txt for the dev environment.
